research_scope: Base-game Parallel Quest skills from PQ 68-80 selected after screening against the canonical skill index and prior research batches. Super Soul rewards were excluded from the skill batch.

verification_audit.method: Skill identity, class, core cost data, and PQ acquisition routes were reconciled against the current Xenoverse 2 skill references and independent PQ reward guides. Exact drop probabilities and version-sensitive frame data were not inferred.

records.name: Angry Shout
records.character_source: Kid Buu; Kid Buu (Supervillain); Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed) (Customize Partner); Janemba; Janemba (Supervillain)
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 68 — Old Rivals and Dragon Balls; reward
records.skill_description: Release a powerful area-of-effect shout that can recover Ki while disrupting nearby opponents.
records.mechanics_notes: The Evasive Skill reference lists Angry Shout at 300 stamina and associates it with PQ68. The documented utility is area control plus Ki recovery; exact current recovery amount and invulnerability timing are not asserted.
records.combo_notes: Primarily an evasive/resource tool rather than a conventional offensive starter.
records.pve_notes: The area effect and Ki recovery can create space against clustered AI opponents.
records.pvp_notes: Its defensive timing and resource recovery are more important than raw damage; exact punish windows remain version-sensitive.

records.name: Headshot
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 69 — God of Destruction and His Master; reward
records.skill_description: Send the opponent flying with a powerful forehead strike.
records.mechanics_notes: The Evasive Skill reference lists Headshot at 300 stamina and PQ69 as its acquisition route. The attack is a short-range physical evasive with knockback; exact invulnerability and startup timing are not asserted.
records.combo_notes: Its principal role is defensive escape with an offensive knockback component.
records.pve_notes: Useful for creating immediate separation from close-range AI pressure.
records.pvp_notes: Exact activation and punish windows should be treated as version-sensitive.

records.name: Emperor's Blast
records.character_source: Frieza (1st Form) (Customize Partner); Golden Frieza; Golden Frieza (Ultra Supervillain)
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 70 — Things Are Getting Serious!; reward
records.skill_description: Turn around and fire a Ki wave behind yourself, useful when expecting an attack from the rear.
records.mechanics_notes: Current skill documentation identifies Emperor's Blast as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super with a rear-facing attack, single hit, and stun behavior. The source documents approximately 15% damage and a three-second stun; exact damage can vary by game conditions and build.
records.combo_notes: The rear-facing firing direction makes this a specialized anti-flank tool rather than a standard forward projectile.
records.pve_notes: Can catch AI enemies approaching from behind or surrounding the user.
records.pvp_notes: Its unusual rear attack direction is the defining matchup property; exact stun interactions remain version-sensitive.

records.name: Burst Kamehameha
records.character_source: SSGSS Goku; Goku (Customize Partner); Goku (Super Saiyan God) (Customize Partner); Goku (GT) (Customize Partner); Goku (Super Saiyan 4) (Customize Partner)
records.skill_description: Fire a Kamehameha and press the input again while the beam is connecting to extend it and spend additional Ki for more damage.
records.mechanics_notes: Current documentation lists Burst Kamehameha as a Ki Blast Super with a 100 Ki initial cost and an additional Ki cost for the follow-up. The second input prolongs the beam and increases damage; exact timing and damage scaling are version-sensitive.
records.combo_notes: The initial beam can connect quickly from suitable attack strings, while the second input should be treated as a separate resource commitment.
records.pve_notes: The optional second input provides flexible damage spending when additional Ki is available.
records.pvp_notes: Its quick initial beam and optional extension make confirmation timing important; exact frame data is not asserted.

records.name: Psychic Move
records.character_source: Frieza (1st Form); Frieza (Final Form); Frieza (Full Power); Golden Frieza; Golden Frieza (Supervillain); God of Destruction Belmod
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 73 — Frieza's Siege Against Earth; reward
records.skill_description: Teleport behind the opponent and create a shockwave that knocks them away.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Evasive Skill documentation identifies Psychic Move as a 300-stamina Strike Evasive. It teleports behind the opponent and produces a short-range shockwave; the source documents approximately 5% damage and knockback.
records.combo_notes: Its teleporting defensive movement is the primary property rather than sustained offense.
records.pve_notes: The rear reposition can break surrounding AI pressure and create immediate distance.
records.pvp_notes: Teleport placement and punish interactions are matchup- and version-sensitive.

records.name: Final Pose
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 74 — Galactic Patrol, Away!; reward
records.skill_description: Perform a defensive pose that grants a temporary combat buff.
records.mechanics_notes: The canonical skill index classifies Final Pose as a Power Up Evasive. PQ74 reward guides consistently identify Final Pose as the skill reward. Exact current buff percentages and stamina/invulnerability behavior require a dedicated mechanics pass.
records.combo_notes: This is a pose/buff-oriented evasive rather than a conventional damage attack.
records.pve_notes: Its temporary buff can be used before sustained PvE pressure when the player has room to activate it.
records.pvp_notes: Activation timing is more important than direct damage; exact buff values remain version-sensitive.

records.name: Counter Burst
records.character_source: Playable/Customize Partner users; exact current user list requires separate roster reconciliation
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 75 — Room to Spare; reward
records.skill_description: Counter an incoming attack with a defensive burst that retaliates against the attacker.
records.mechanics_notes: The canonical skill index classifies Counter Burst as a Counter Skill and PQ75 reward guides identify the acquisition route. Exact stamina use, activation window, and damage properties require dedicated counter-system verification.
records.combo_notes: Designed around reacting to incoming attacks rather than initiating conventional strings.
records.pve_notes: Can punish predictable close-range AI attacks when timed correctly.
records.pvp_notes: Counter timing and the opponent's ability to bait the activation are central; exact frame data remains unresolved.

records.name: Warp Kamehameha
records.character_source: Goku; SSGSS Goku; Goku (GT) (Customize Partner); Goku (Super Saiyan 4) (Customize Partner); Cell (Perfect) (Customize Partner); Gogeta (Super Saiyan 4) (Customize Partner); Goku Black (Customize Partner); SSGSS Vegito (Customize Partner); SSGSS Gogeta (Customize Partner); Gogeta (DB Super)
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 76 — Eternal Rival; Ultimate Finish reward
records.skill_description: Charge a Kamehameha, teleport to the locked-on opponent, and fire the beam at close range.
records.mechanics_notes: Current documentation identifies Warp Kamehameha as a 400-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate with teleport, tracking, long-range, and 24-hit characteristics. The source documents approximately 30% damage; exact scaling remains build- and version-sensitive.
records.combo_notes: The teleport component changes its spacing compared with ordinary Kamehameha ultimates.
records.pve_notes: Its lock-on teleport can connect from significant distance when the target remains valid.
records.pvp_notes: Teleport targeting is the defining interaction; exact startup, tracking, and punish behavior remain version-sensitive.

records.name: Ki Explosion
records.character_source: Vegeta; Nappa; Saibaman; Captain Ginyu; Cell (Perfect); Cabba; CaCs
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 77 — Parent and Child; reward
records.skill_description: Detonate Ki around the user in a rapid short-range explosion; holding the input consumes additional Ki to extend the attack.
records.mechanics_notes: Current documentation identifies Ki Explosion as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. Holding the input can consume additional Ki, up to four Ki bars according to the source, to prolong the explosion.
records.combo_notes: Its fast area coverage makes it suitable for catching nearby movement and can be used during appropriate combo sequences.
records.pve_notes: The short-range area effect is useful against clustered AI targets.
records.pvp_notes: Fast activation and area coverage are its main documented strengths; exact frame data remains version-sensitive.

records.name: Dust Attack
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 78 — Heated, Furious, Ultimate Battle; reward
records.skill_description: Fire a short-range Ki attack that produces a dust cloud and blinds the target.
records.mechanics_notes: Current community references identify Dust Attack as the PQ78 skill and describe a short-range Ki explosion whose dust cloud blinds opponents. Exact current blind duration and damage values are not asserted.
records.combo_notes: The blindness effect is the primary utility rather than raw damage.
records.pve_notes: Blinding an AI target can create a temporary opening for follow-up attacks.
records.pvp_notes: The status effect is the defining property; exact duration and counterplay require version-specific testing.

records.name: Mighty Explosive Wave
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 79 — Great Ape Festival; reward
records.skill_description: Create a Ki explosion around the user that hits nearby opponents and knocks them away.
records.mechanics_notes: Current documentation identifies the standard PQ79 version as a Ki Blast Super costing 100 Ki. The skill produces a short-range explosion with up to six hits; an Evasive variant exists separately and should not be conflated with this record.
records.combo_notes: The short-range explosion can serve as a close-range area attack rather than a projectile.
records.pve_notes: Area coverage is useful when multiple AI targets are close to the user.
records.pvp_notes: Keep the Super and Evasive variants separate when documenting stamina costs and defensive properties.

records.name: Dimensional Hole
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 80 — The Return of the Giant Ape-Fest!; reward
records.skill_description: Open a dimensional portal as a counter, using the incoming attack to reposition and retaliate.
records.mechanics_notes: The canonical skill index classifies Dimensional Hole as a Counter Skill and PQ80 reward guides identify the acquisition route. Exact stamina cost, activation window, teleport behavior, and damage require dedicated counter-system verification.
records.combo_notes: Counter-oriented utility should be documented separately from the similarly named Dimensional Cannon Evasive.
records.pve_notes: Can punish predictable attacks while creating positional separation.
records.pvp_notes: The counter window and baitability are important matchup considerations; exact frame data remains unresolved.
